classification: Opt-in decision evidence pack: service assembly and verification endpoints with an SDK offline evidence-pack module
receiptImpact: Existing OracleSafetyCheck and ExecutionReceipt layouts, registry release, attester keys, partner policies, and activation set v6 remain unchanged. Insight adds opt-in decision evidence pack endpoints that assemble and verify already persisted audit artifacts into one manifest-hashed pack, and the SDK adds an offline evidence-pack verification module plus a canonical JSON export. The pack is review evidence, not authorization, and no partner policy or partner production verifier admission changes.
activationRule: Consumers must explicitly call the evidence pack endpoints or SDK module; the pack verifies bytes and linkage, grants no execution capability, and does not substitute for verify-insight-receipt or PriorSeal verification. Existing SDK and service behavior is unchanged and opt-in compatible. This promotion does not change partner activations, grant partner reliance, authorize live execution, or publish an npm package.
